2607.29539.title: ARB: A Matched Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark Dataset for AI-Text Detector Evaluation
2607.29539.paper_summary: Standard AI-text detection benchmarks compare human-written text against text generated directly by large language models (LLMs). While prior work has shown that rewriting and paraphrasing can degrade detector performance, it remains unclear whether performance measured on this conventional benchmark predicts detector behavior when human-authored content is rewritten by an LLM. To address this gap, we introduce Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark (ARB), built from 1,800 human source texts (600 each from XSum, WritingPrompts, and OpenWebText) and four open-weight generators (Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B, Gemma-2-9B). Each source item yields four matched variants: human-written (HUMAN), direct LLM generation (Free-LLM), LLM-rewritten human text (H2L), and same-generator LLM-rewritten LLM text (LLM2L). We evaluated five detectors (FastDetectGPT, Binoculars-falcon-7b, RADAR, BERT-Defense, RoBERTa-Defense) at a strict 1%-false-positive operating point (TPR@1%FPR). FastDetectGPT and Binoculars-falcon-7b detected 91.2% and 93.5\% of direct LLM text, but only 30.8% and 15.1% of human text an LLM had rewritten, a drop of 60-78 percentage points. The same detectors retained 78.3% and 83.0% recall when LLM text was rewritten by the same model, a much smaller decline of 10-13 points. RADAR followed the same pattern (66.8% to 12.2%), while BERT-Defense and RoBERTa-Defense stayed below 3% recall across all regimes. These results show that detector performance measured on the conventional human-vs-LLM benchmark does not transfer to human-authored text revised by an LLM, even though the same detectors remain largely robust to LLM-only rewriting.
2607.29539.paper_summary_zh: 標準的 AI 文本檢測基準將人類撰寫的文本與大型語言模型 (LLMs) 直接生成的文本進行比較。<lb/>雖然先前的研究顯示重寫和改述可能會降低檢測器的性能，但仍不清楚在這一傳統基準上測量的性能是否能預測當人類創作的內容被 LLM 重寫時檢測器的行為。<lb/>為了解決這一空白，我們引入了作者重寫基準 (Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark, ARB)，該基準由 1,800 篇人類來源文本（來自 XSum、WritingPrompts 和 OpenWebText 各 600 篇）和四個開放權重生成器（Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Gemma-2-9B）構建而成。<lb/>每個來源項目產生四個匹配變體：人類撰寫 (HUMAN)、直接 LLM 生成 (Free-LLM)、LLM 重寫的人類文本 (H2L)，以及同一生成器重寫的 LLM 文本 (LLM2L)。<lb/>我們在嚴格的 1% 假陽性操作點 (TPR@1%FPR) 評估了五個檢測器（FastDetectGPT、Binoculars-falcon-7b、RADAR、BERT-Defense、RoBERTa-Defense）。<lb/>FastDetectGPT 和 Binoculars-falcon-7b 檢測到了 91.2% 和 93.5% 的直接 LLM 文本，但僅檢測到 30.8% 和 15.1% 的人類文本，這些文本被 LLM 重寫，下降幅度達 60-78 個百分點。<lb/>同樣的檢測器在 LLM 文本被同一模型重寫時保持了 78.3% 和 83.0% 的召回率，下降幅度僅為 10-13 個百分點。<lb/>RADAR 也遵循相同的模式（66.8% 降至 12.2%），而 BERT-Defense 和 RoBERTa-Defense 在所有情況下的召回率均低於 3%。<lb/>這些結果表明，在傳統的人類與 LLM 基準上測量的檢測器性能並不適用於 LLM 修訂的人類創作文本，即使相同的檢測器在 LLM 僅重寫時仍然保持相對穩健。
